explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1171: for every finite k, ω₁² → (ω₁·ω, 3, …, 3)²_{k+1}. OrdinalMultiColorRamsey asks, for every (k+1)-colouring of pairs, for either a colour-0 set of order type ω₁·ω or a 3-element set monochromatic in some nonzero colour. The k = 0 case is trivially true, which is harmless. The open question is stated affirmatively.
